project_description.value: Replace and upgrade HVAC exhaust systems in Building 1816, a depot-level MK-48 torpedo maintenance facility at Naval Weapons Station Yorktown. Scope includes replacement of three rooftop air handling units (AHU-14, AHU-15, AHU-16), fourteen exhaust fans (EF-8 through EF-21), new ductwork for AHU-14 and AHU-15, supplemental boiler, hot water pump replacement, DDC controls upgrade, and hazardous material abatement (ACM, lead paint, PCBs).

otto_fuel_context.value: Rooms 101, 102, and 103 handle Otto Fuel II (propylene glycol dinitrate, ~75% of fuel) during torpedo defueling/refueling. Negative pressure ventilation (0.05–0.10 in H2O) required to prevent fume spread.
otto_fuel_context.quote: MK-48 torpedoes are propelled by a very toxic and highly volatile Otto fuel II. The fuel contains propylene glycol dinitrate (PGDN) as the major constituent, representing approximately 75 percent of the total fuel.

conflict_flags.rationale: The Scope of Work (Attachment 5) and BOD both consistently label the project 'FY 22 PROJECT RM 22-0238'. The SAES document title shows 'FY21 SPECIAL PROJECT RM 22-0238' but the project number (RM 22-0238) is consistent. The discrepancy likely reflects an evolving project: the SAES may have been drafted in FY21 and revised into FY22 (Rev 18, dated APR 2021 on all docs). The SOW/BOD are the more scope-defining documents.

'Replace' is used in the two primary technical documents (BOD and SOW). 'Repair' in the SAES administrative cover document may reflect an earlier draft title. The scope clearly involves full replacement of AHUs and exhaust fans, not repair.
